'''Alternate Image''' ('''AI''') is a Decipher printing of a rare with different artwork and the same title and game text. The wiki dests that printing as [[Title (AI)]].

[[Tatooine]] packed nine alternate-image rares. Each of those rares appears eight times on the rare sheet; two of the eight are the AI version (except [[Boonta Eve Podrace]], nine times per side).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
